artworks.title: The Sacrifice of Marcus Curtius
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person in full armor riding a rearing horse. The person is facing forward, wearing a plumed helmet and detailed armor. They hold a sword in their right hand. The horse has flowing manes and a muscular appearance. The background is plain. The drawing is on light-colored paper, in fine lines resembling a sketch.

artworks.title: Two Women in Classical Dress
artworks.medium: brush and black and brown inks and wash over black chalk on apricot prepared paper,laid down
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals standing side by side. The person on the left has short curly hair and is wearing a loose, flowing garment. The person on the right has longer curly hair pulled back and is dressed in a draped garment with one shoulder exposed. Both individuals are shown from head to toe. The background is a simple, monochromatic surface primarily in shades of brown.

artworks.title: Esurientes pascere
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in an ancient setting. The artwork depicts multiple individuals occupying various roles, set against an elaborate architectural landscape. The composition includes figures dressed in robes, with some reclining and others standing, against a structured environment consisting of stone structures and lush trees. The drawing is intricately detailed, capturing depth with shading and fine lines. The overall atmosphere suggests a narrative moment.

artworks.title: Potare sitientes
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people gathered in an architectural setting among ruins and natural surroundings. The scene is populated by figures engaged in various activities. In the foreground, a central figure kneels beside large urns. The gathered individuals display a range of expressions and postures, from attentive to curious. Architectural elements like grand columns and archways are visible in the background. The use of shading and line work brings depth to the scene, with lush foliage adding to the composition.

artworks.title: Hospitio exipere advenas
artworks.description: This image depicts multiple figures interacting in a classical setting. Several figures are gathered, some seated and others standing, amidst columns, drapery, and classical architecture. The characters are engaged in activities such as pouring and mixing liquid in vessels. The scene includes elaborate clothing drapery and a backdrop showing trees and a large building with smokestacks. The drawing exhibits a high level of craftsmanship, typical of classical or neoclassical themes, possibly inspired by ancient literature or mythology.

artworks.title: Vestine nudos
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of a bustling scene in a historical setting. The drawing shows a large group of individuals gathered around a central figure. The figures are dressed in traditional garments indicating a historical or ancient timeframe. The background includes architecture with large arches and columns, creating depth. The drawing captures expressions and movements with fine strokes, bringing the setting to life. In the foreground, there are animals and scattered objects, adding to the narrative of the illustration. The composition presents a moment of historical or literary significance, paying attention to human and architectural details.

artworks.title: Aegros Curare
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an angel overseeing a scene set in ancient architecture with figures in flowing garments. The composition includes classical architectural elements and multiple figures in various poses. An angelic figure floats above, holding a sword or staff. Structures suggest an ancient setting with arches, towers, and distant landscapes. Figures convey emotion through gestures and interactions, such as tending to wounded or sleeping individuals. The line work, light, and shadow emphasize the drama and complexity of the scene.

artworks.title: Liberare Captivos
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ancient ceremonial or historical scene. The image depicts a grand historical setting featuring detailed architectural structures such as arches and a castle in the background. Numerous figures are engaged in various activities; some are clad in robes, while others appear to be armored soldiers. A statue of a horse is present amidst the gathering. The figures are distributed across the composition, interacting in a way that suggests negotiation or instruction. The background is dominated by towering architecture and trees, with voluminous clouds billowing above, creating a sense of depth and drama. The intricate lines and shading contribute to a rich, textural quality.

artworks.title: Sepelire mortuos
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group gathering around a deceased figure. The artwork depicts an outdoor setting with classical architecture and lush vegetation in the background, including pillars and statues. The scene shows emotional expressions and activities surrounding a motionless figure on the ground. Surrounding figures are engaged in gestures of grief and consolation. The drawing has depth and texture enhanced by light and shadow, creating a poignant composition.

artworks.title: Mercury with the Head of Argus in His Hand
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape viewed from an elevated perspective, showing a countryside with a horizon filled with mountains and sky. In the foreground, a shepherd tends to his flock and another figure rests on the ground. A stream or path leads through hilly terrain with trees and buildings towards a village or town. The scene conveys depth through distant hills and mountains. The artwork is detailed with intricate lines, characteristic of an etching, creating textures in clouds and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, employing contrast between light and dark lines to define details. Mythical figures are present in the clouds above.

artworks.title: Ruins on the Palatine with the Septizonium
artworks.description: The image shows a scene of ancient architecture ruins, with the sky taking up the top third of the composition, featuring faint clouds. The ruins, including arches and tall structures, are spread across the composition, with detailed linework and monochromatic colors highlighting light and shadow. The foreground displays broken columns, scattered stones, and vegetation, with the ruins extending into the distance. The background features a skyline with wispy clouds above the ancient structures.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body figures placed within an interior setting. On the left, an angel with large wings and curly hair is shown with one hand raised and the other holding a stem of flowers. The angel wears flowing garments with drapery detailing. On the right stands a woman, possibly a virgin, with long hair and delicate features, dressed in robes and extending one arm forward. The space around them includes clouds with cherubic faces and architectural elements such as a window with patterns and a book on a slanted surface. The background features structured interior elements like arches, columns, and fabric textures.

artworks.title: The Virgin in Glory
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash heightened with white over black chalk on blue paper
artworks.description: The image shows a central female figure elevated among clouds. She has long hair and wears flowing robes. Cherubic figures surround her. The scene has a celestial quality, with soft clouds and rays in the background. Two additional figures are positioned on either side of the central figure. The background consists of swirling clouds.

artworks.title: Grottesco with the Tomb of Nero
artworks.medium: pen and gray-brown ink over red chalk, tip of the brush with gray ink, gray wash
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Philip Hofer in memory of his mother, Mrs. Jane Arms Hofer
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing from an elevated angle, focusing on classical architectural details. The piece features an ornate structure with inscriptions and decorations, obscured by swirling forms. An urn on a column is visible on the right. The artist uses diverse brushstrokes to depict light and shadow, with a color palette of gray and sepia tones. The foreground includes small figures engaged in activities, while the background fades into a blur.

artworks.title: Study of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Bertha Leubsdorf in memory of her parents, Sophie and Carl Boschwitz
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a woman from her waist up. She is in a slightly angled, three-quarter position with a detailed face showing a gentle expression. Her hair is styled back and her off-the-shoulder garment drapes around her arms. The woman's right hand is on her hip, and her left arm is bent with the hand behind her head. The background is plain with a neutral, light brown tone.

artworks.title: Design for Hawk Dress for Mrs. C.E. Hunter as Queen Phalema in "The Seraph"
The Head of Saint John the Evangelist
artworks.medium: oil on paper lined with linen

artworks.title: Paradise, Newport
artworks.creditLine: Adolph Caspar Miller Fund and Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash, squared with black chalk, on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows three figures prominently, along with a child. The person on the left is seated, holding a baby in their arms, with their whole upper body visible. The person's hair is wavy, and their facial features appear soft and attentive while they look at the child. They are dressed in loose, flowing garments. To the right, another person is kneeling, attending to a bundle or pot, with their back turned. This person's attire is similar, with long sleeves and a flowing garment. An angelic figure with wings appears in the background, with facial features partially obscured by their positioning and hair slightly wavy. The background includes architectural elements like buildings with pointed rooftops and a church steeple, surrounded by trees and foliage that frame the scene. There is a donkey lying nearby, and a tree extends its branches across the top of the image.

artworks.title: Allegory of Music
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with red wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a seated figure surrounded by cherubs. The scene is composed within an oval border, featuring an adult figure sitting amongst a group of playful cherubs. The figure is draped in flowing clothing, while the cherubs are depicted in various playful poses around the central figure, amidst stylized clouds. The drawing is executed with loose, expressive strokes and shading, with a monochromatic palette of soft browns and reddish tints that suggest the use of sepia ink or similar medium. The scene conveys a sense of movement and celestial harmony.

artworks.title: Brinkman Priory
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Leonard and Mary Schlosser
artworks.description: The image shows an old, partially ruined priory. The structure is viewed from an angle, emphasizing its architecture. There are trees around the priory. The horizon is not clearly depicted. The drawing is detailed, created with precise ink lines. The color scheme is monochromatic, with black ink on light paper. Vegetation surrounds the priory in the foreground, leading the eye towards it. In the background, the priory stands in partial ruin, surrounded by trees.

artworks.title: Country Footbridge (The Traveller)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Leonard and Mary Schlosser
artworks.description: The illustration depicts a view from slightly above, showing a pathway, trees, a footbridge, a person walking, and a tower in the distance. The horizon is not clearly defined, suggesting a gentle rise towards the trees and the tower. The style is reminiscent of fine inkwork, with detailed lines, cross-hatching for texture, and shading. The color palette is monochromatic, with black ink on a cream or off-white background.

artworks.title: Four Boys on a Beach
artworks.medium: graphite with watercolor and gouache on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: John Davis Hatch Collection, Andrew W. Mellon Fund

artworks.title: Solitude: Miss Vesta Rollinstall
artworks.medium: graphite on heavy cream wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil drawing of a woman's upper three-quarters body in profile. She is standing near a window with her hands clasped in front of her. The woman has softly sketched facial features, slightly tilted head, and a focused gaze looking downward. Her hair is styled up. She wears a long-sleeved dress with a high collar and a brooch at the neckline. The background features abstract lines and shading, with light coming through the window.
